dedupe_keys.name: historico de suscriptores residenciales de acueducto san pedro

description: Histórico de Suscriptores Residenciales de Acueducto San Pedro is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Alcaldía de San Pedro de Los Milagros, Antioquia. La base de datos contiene el histórico del número de suscriptores residenciales de acueducto del municipio de San Pedro de los Milagros, desde el año 2017 hasta el 2023. Coverage: Alcaldía de San Pedro de Los Milagros, Antioquia. The portal files it under the publisher Alcaldía de San Pedro de Los Milagros, Antioquia. Its tags are acueducto, suscriptores. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Vivienda, Ciudad y Territorio. The portal shows 2025-10-17 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
